summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7 nodes had only mariadb-libs, no server), populated appdb.orders with 4 committed rows, took the cluster fully down for a maintenance window, correctly cold-restarted it (bootstrapping from the most-advanced node per grastate.dat), rejoined all members, and verified all data and 3-way membership recovered. Also completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot identity changes and full cluster/data recovery after each while preserving quorum.
actions_performed: Diagnosed that no MariaDB/Galera server was installed on any node (only mariadb-libs); no yum repos were enabled
Configured MariaDB archive repo (10.5, el7) and enabled rhel-7-server-rpms base repo on all 3 nodes
Installed MariaDB-server, MariaDB-client, galera (galera-4 wsrep provider) on node1/node2/node3
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on all nodes with gcomm cluster address and rsync SST method
Fixed /etc/hosts, opened firewalld ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 on all nodes
Bootstrapped node1 via galera_new_cluster, generated root password on-node, created appdb.orders table with committed rows
Joined node2 then node3 via SST; verified cluster_size 1->2->3, all Synced
Propagated root credentials between nodes via cluster SSH key/scp without exposing secrets in commands/output
Inserted an additional committed row and confirmed 4-row replication to all 3 nodes pre-maintenance
Cleanly stopped mariadb on node3, node2, then node1 (full cluster down for maintenance window)
Inspected grastate.dat on all nodes; node1 had highest seqno (11) and safe_to_bootstrap=1
Ran galera_new_cluster on node1 to cold-restart the primary component, verified all 4 rows present
Started mariadb on node2 then node3; both rejoined via SST, cluster_size reached 3, all Synced, all 4 rows present on every node
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and Galera health baseline on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node3 via systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full Galera/data recovery (cluster_size 3, Synced, 4 rows)
Rebooted node2 the same way, confirmed changed boot_id and recovery
Rebooted node1 last (quorum preserved throughout since 2/3 stayed up during each reboot), confirmed changed boot_id and recovery
Final cross-check: all 3 nodes report wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, and 4 committed rows in appdb.orders

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster established and serving application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, appdb.orders created with data, node2 and node3 joined via SST reaching cluster_size=3, Synced, with data replicated

evidence.requirement: Additional committed write present on all members before maintenance
evidence.summary: widget-4-pre-maintenance row inserted on node2 and confirmed present on node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
evidence.summary: wsrep_last_committed confirmed equal (seqno 9) on all nodes, then mariadb stopped sequentially on node3, node2, node1 (all inactive)

evidence.requirement: Correct cold-restart procedure (bootstrap from most-advanced node)
evidence.summary: grastate.dat showed node1 at seqno 11 (safe_to_bootstrap=1) vs node2 seqno 10 and node3 seqno 9; node1 bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster and all 4 rows verified present

evidence.requirement: All three members rejoined and serving after maintenance, committed writes intact
evidence.summary: node2 and node3 rejoined via SST, cluster_size reached 3, both Synced, all 4 orders rows present on each

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol: node1 baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1a816f1f captured with cluster_size=3/Synced; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id da22a164 (changed); cluster_size=3, Synced, 4 rows confirmed after restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol: node2 baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdbfa15c with cluster_size=3/Synced; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 5fe12142 (changed); cluster_size=3, Synced, 4 rows confirmed after restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol: node3 baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state

evidence.summary: Nodes were rebooted strictly one at a time (node3, then node2, then node1) with the other two members remaining active and Synced during each individual reboot
